footer.author: André Pereira
footer.aboutDescription: A property developer in Lousada. We design, build and sell houses in northern Portugal.

meta.title: New homes in Lousada and northern Portugal
meta.description: ImmoLux designs, builds and sells houses and apartments in Lousada and the surrounding area. See what is for sale now.

hero.headline: New homes in northern Portugal.
hero.lead: We design and build in Lousada and the parishes around it. These are the ones for sale right now.
hero.leadEmpty: We design and build in Lousada and the parishes around it.
hero.comingSoonBody: New properties appear here as soon as work starts on site. Write to us to hear what is coming.

studio.headline: We build the houses we sell.
studio.body: ImmoLux is a developer based in Lousada. We follow every house from the plot to the deed — and we follow the buyer, whether they are in Portugal, Belgium or France.
studio.facts: Lousada, Portugal · 15 years on site · 3 European markets
studio.whereValue: Lousada, in the district of Porto. We work in the parishes we know, not across the whole map.
studio.howValue: Architecture and construction in-house. Finishes are chosen, not inherited from a catalogue.
studio.whoValue: Fifteen years between Portugal and the Benelux. We answer in Portuguese, French and English.
studio.partnerValue: PacaGroup, Belgian builders, with us from the start.

portugal.headline: Four reasons to buy here.
portugal.solBody: Long dry summers, mild wet winters. Considerably more sun than northern Europe.
portugal.mercadoBody: House prices have risen steadily for a decade, with foreign demand still growing.
portugal.mesaBody: Good food, a cost of living below the European average, and Porto forty minutes away.
portugal.abrigoBody: One of the safest countries in the world, with a national health service across all of it.

contact.body: Size, area, budget — whatever you already know is enough to start. We answer in Portuguese, French or English.
contact.ownersBody: We list third-party properties on the platform. Write to us about partnerships.
contact.headline: Tell us what you are looking for.
